integrity: The proof reconstructs the signed-order facets from the primary source, converts normalized root clearances into a weighted antipodally symmetric DAG, proves a sharp path upper bound, and constructs a matching antisymmetric potential by symmetrizing longest-path lower envelopes. The finite active-set replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard Euclidean realization of signed order polytopes and requires the irredundant minimal-representation facet system. It does not classify uniqueness of the incenter for every signed poset and does not determine minimum enclosing spheres or extremal ellipsoids. A general Chebyshev theorem for antipodally doubled difference-constraint systems remains a residual originality risk.
title: A longest signed path gives the exact Euclidean inradius of every signed order polytope
